review_type: Independent review of advisory response text

scoring.scale: 0 absent/incorrect; 1 partial or material omission; 2 sufficiently supported and useful for this case.
scoring.pass_rule: PASS requires total >= 8/10, all must_include properties evidenced and no hard_fail. A high score cannot compensate for a mandatory omission. NOT_MET denotes missing mandatory response evidence; it does not necessarily mean unsafe behavior.
scoring.interpretation: Semantic equivalents accepted. Case-specific requirements are checked against the actual supplied response, without silently filling omissions from package documentation.

summary.interpretation: Generally strong advisory responses with four strict mandatory-completeness gaps. No installed-host or device performance conclusion follows.

methodology_limits: Reviewed only response text, explicit case criteria and relevant package guidance. Did not inspect other evaluation notes, install/test an assistant host, access a tenant, send MDM commands, inspect device state or modify a live system/repository.

Source context was limited to relevant vendor-source, command-compatibility, operational-guardrail, app-self-service and AppleCare references plus Wi-Fi recovery, ASM and audit skill text. Source claims in package files were treated as context, not automatic proof.

Public primary-source spot checks covered the documented restart/Wi-Fi warning, Apple Business naming and launch date, School API base URL, app installation methods, timed profiles, category-key deprecation, APNs renewal sequence and ACE device-pool distinction. Not every citation or technical detail in all 20 responses was independently re-opened.

Some embedded citation identifiers are opaque without their original browser session. Readable URLs were used where available; a claim that sources were checked on a given date is not itself proof of the original retrieval process.

The Apple naming-notice page returned HTTP 429 on independent open. Its official search extract plus Apple's primary newsroom announcement corroborated the naming/launch point. Regional feature availability was not tested.

These are single-turn advisory evaluations. Promises to adapt, verify or obtain authority later are evaluated as proposed process only; actual follow-through, pilot reliability, communication delivery and data handling are untested.

E02's missing account-password distinction, E11's general-knowledge boundary and E13's regional gate are absence-of-response-evidence judgments. No incorrect account recovery, real data ingestion/privacy breach or region-incompatible change was observed.
The package is specialized in Jamf School, but E03's supplied prompt does not confirm that product. The explicit product-confirmation requirement was therefore enforced.
Scores are ordinal reviewer judgments, not calibrated accuracy percentages or statistically representative deployment evidence. No independent reviewers/subagents were used in this review.
